name: Architecture Pipeline - AI Agent with Ollama

parameters.content:
## Architecture Pipeline with AI Agents

**Pattern:** Two-step capability lookup
1. Search Qdrant for capabilities
2. Pass results to agent (no tools)

**Trigger:** POST /webhook/architecture-pipeline

## Phase 2: Business Architecture
Deterministic Qdrant retrieval

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO architecture.projects (slug, name, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, now())
ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, slug, name;

SELECT content, version, content_hash, created_at
FROM architecture.artifacts
WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'brd'
ORDER BY version DESC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.output: ={{ (() => { const s = $('Apply Classification + Slugify').first().json.startAt; if (s === 'application_architect') return 2; if (s === 'business_architect') return 1; return 0; })() }}

parameters.query:
WITH next_version AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v
  FROM architecture.artifacts
  WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'brd'
)
INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta)
SELECT $1, 'brd', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb
FROM next_version
RETURNING id, version;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Upsert Project').first().json.id, JSON.stringify($json.brd), $json.brdHash, JSON.stringify({ model: $('Run Config').first().json.ollamaModel, seed: $('Run Config').first().json.ollamaSeed, temperature: $('Run Config').first().json.ollamaTemperature }) ] }}

parameters.prompt: =healthcare capabilities relevant to this project: {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate BRD').first().json.brd).substring(0, 600) }}
